_note: The shared local CI runner's job list for this repository (#366). Every job is always selected, as the private runner it replaces ran every job on every run, and chain stops at the first failure, as ci.yml's needs: chain does. tests/Unit/CiParityTest.php holds the job order against ci.yml. ci.yml's last job, `ci`, has no counterpart here: it aggregates the remote jobs into the `CI` check the ruleset requires, and this run does not gate a merge (D-105). ci.yml runs each job on ubuntu-latest and windows-latest (#25); this runs each job once, on the host's own operating system.
_prepare: patches is off: prepare runs before any job, so it would reinstall the slot's old package versions against the commit's patches. The dependencies job installs first and re-syncs patches second, as the private runner did.

jobs.name: dependencies
jobs._note: Local only. Installs the root setup and the Integration setup (tests/Integration) from their locks in the runner's own slot, and refuses a stale tree anywhere else; see scripts/prepare-dependencies.mjs.

jobs.name: lint-floor
jobs._note: Parses every shipped PHP file with the supported floor, PHP 8.2, which no test runs on (#375). tests/ is left out: the suites run only on the development PHP and may use its syntax.

jobs.name: floor-functions
jobs._note: Asks PHP 8.2 about each call in a shipped file to a function a development polyfill defines; PHPStan cannot see past a polyfill for a function newer than the PHP it runs on (#399). Reads the polyfills the dependencies job installed.

jobs.name: synced-files
jobs._note: A hand edit to a file the shared sync manages fails the run. ci.yml runs it too, since #10.

jobs.name: handed-back-workflow
jobs._note: Fails when .github/workflows/clear-handed-back.yml differs from the shared template or is missing. ci.yml runs it too, since #10.

jobs.name: download-archive
jobs._note: Lists `git archive` of HEAD under the working tree's .gitattributes and fails naming anything the plugin does not run (#439). Always, because a new top-level path anywhere can break it. ci.yml runs it too, since #10.

jobs.name: aggregate-needs
jobs._note: Fails naming a ci.yml job missing from the CI job's needs: list, or a required check name no job reports (#10). Copied by hand from uams-claude-skills ahead of the sync that will list it.

jobs.name: spell
jobs._note: No node_modules requirement: the runner checks requires before any job runs, so one would skip this job in a slot the dependencies job has not yet filled. An absent tree fails instead.

jobs.name: rector
jobs._note: --clear-cache: the slot is reused, and Rector skips any file whose content is unchanged, so a warm cache could hide a rule that a change elsewhere now fires. ci.yml runs cold in a fresh temp dir. The runner's single-flight lock means no concurrent Rector shares this slot's cache.

jobs.name: mutate-ignore-breadth
jobs._note: Measures each @pest-mutate-ignore with the installed pest-plugin-mutate and fails naming any that removes other than one mutant per mutator it names (#31). Local only for now: ci.yml is being changed by #25, and the step lands there after it. No vendor requirement, for the reason the spell job gives: an absent plugin fails instead. The paths are named because the default `tests` walks into tests/Integration/vendor, whose pest-plugin-mutate carries markers of its own.
jobs.run: php .claude/skills/pest-testing/scripts/check-mutate-ignore-breadth.php includes tests/Unit tests/Support tests/Integration/Feature tests/Integration/Mutate tests/Integration/bootstrap.php tests/Integration/Pest.php tests/Integration/wp-tests-config.php

jobs.name: pest
jobs._note: The unit suite from the root setup, then the Integration suite from tests/Integration four times: as a network and as a single site, each once without and once with the shared secret defined. See scripts/run-pest-suites.php.

jobs.name: node-test
jobs._note: Needs the npm tree: scripts/check-path-portability.mjs imports acorn. The dependencies job's npm ci fills it here; ci.yml's node-test job runs its own npm ci (#477). No node_modules requirement, for the reason the spell job gives.
